coverage.title: From The Lancet: in an urgent care setting, the advice of the obsolete Gemini 2.5 Pro & Gemini 2.5 Flash (without access to patient medical records) were rated of similar quality to doctors by other physicians. There was no safety issues spotted. Models have gotten significantly better since.

Không có vấn đề an toàn nào được ghi nhận. Kể từ đó, các mô hình đã trở nên tốt hơn đáng kể.
